settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Begin by cleansing your skin with the Mangosteen Cleanser to remove impurities and prep the surface.
  2. Mist lightly with the Infused Conductive Solution to hydrate and enhance conductivity.
  3. Apply a thin layer of ATP Booster Gel to treatment areas.
  4. Connect your MyoLift Mini to the hands-free masks (Eye or Lip) or use the Conductive Gloves for precision work.
  5. Run the MyoLift Mini on Erase mode for smoothing and Educate mode for toning.
  6. After treatment, remove masks and massage in any remaining serum or gel.
  7. Finish with the Anti-Aging Peptide Serum and Eye Lift Serum to lock in moisture and rejuvenate the skin.

settings.title: Who is this for?

  • Users targeting visible wrinkles, fine lines, and early signs of aging.
  • Skincare enthusiasts who want professional-level lifting and smoothing results at home.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text1: Ideal for first-time MyoLift Mini users or anyone targeting fine lines, wrinkles, and early signs of aging at home.
settings.title2: How does this kit improve skin firmness?
settings.text2: The Mini device uses microcurrent to stimulate facial muscles, while the included skincare boosts hydration, collagen support, and elasticity for a lifted appearance.
settings.title3: How long should each session last?
settings.text3: Sessions typically last 10–20 minutes, using the Erase mode for smoothing wrinkles and Educate mode for toning.
settings.title4: Do I need to use all the masks every session?
settings.text4: Not necessarily. Use masks according to your treatment focus: eye, lip, or full-face for maximum results.
settings.text5: Apply the ATP Booster Gel and Infused Conductive Solution as directed. Proper hydration ensures the Mini device works efficiently.
settings.title6: Can I combine this kit with other skincare routines?
settings.text6: Yes. The kit is compatible with your regular moisturizers and serums, applied after microcurrent treatment.
